description: Implementation of RateReadService for accessing rate data from the database, including methods to retrieve all rates, specific rates by ID or name, and loan-related rates.

classes.name: RateReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing RateReadService to fetch rate data from database.

classes.name: RateMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to RateData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllRates
methods.description: Fetches all rate records from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific rate by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveByName
methods.description: Retrieves a rate by its name.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicableRates
methods.description: Fetches all active loan applicable rates.

methods.name: retrieveLoanRates
methods.description: Fetches rates associated with a specific loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveProductLoanRates
methods.description: Fetches rates associated with a specific product loan ID.
